title: Authentication & session management
businessValue: Users can create an account, sign in securely, and stay signed in across short interruptions without re-entering credentials.
scope: Covers signup with account validation, email+password signin, and signout. Session refresh is handled internally via UserToken{type=SESSION_REFRESH}. Does NOT cover SSO, password reset, or MFA (tracked as separate Epics).

urs.narrative: As a new user, I can create an account with an email and a password so I can access the product.
As a returning user, I can sign in with my email and password to resume using the product.
As a signed-in user, I can sign out on demand so my session on a shared device is terminated.

frs.title: Email + password signin
frs.description: POST /auth/signin validates credentials against User.password (bcrypt) and issues a short-lived access JWT + a SESSION_REFRESH UserToken.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid credentials return 200 with an access token and a refresh token (cookie or body depending on deployment).
Invalid credentials return 401 with a generic error message (no user-enumeration leak).
An inactive User (User.isActive=false) cannot sign in; the response invites the user to validate their account first.

frs.title: Signup with account validation
frs.description: POST /auth/signup creates a User with isActive=false and a UserToken{type=ACCOUNT_VALIDATION}. Account becomes usable only after the validation token is consumed (typically via an email link).
acceptanceCriteria: Unique email + valid password return 200 and queue an account-validation token + email.
Duplicate email is handled gracefully with a generic response (no user-enumeration leak).
Unvalidated accounts have User.isActive=false and cannot sign in until the token is consumed.

frs.title: Signout
frs.description: POST /auth/signout revokes the caller's SESSION_REFRESH UserToken so the refresh chain for this session can no longer be used.
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated caller receives 200 and their SESSION_REFRESH token is invalidated.
Subsequent refresh attempts with the revoked token return 401.
Unauthenticated callers receive 401 without leaking whether the token existed.

dsItems.title: Data model — User
dsItems.description: Prisma model User { id, email @unique, password, isActive @default(false), peopleId?, lastLoginAt? }. Passwords hashed with bcrypt. isActive gates signin until the ACCOUNT_VALIDATION token is consumed.

dsItems.title: Data model — UserToken
dsItems.description: Prisma model UserToken { id, userId, token, type: TokenType, expiresAt? } with enum TokenType { ACCOUNT_VALIDATION, SESSION_REFRESH, PASSWORD_RESET, INVITATION }. @@unique([userId, type]) enforces one live token per (user, type).

dsItems.title: API contract — POST /auth/signin
dsItems.description: Body: SignInDto { email, password }. Response: SignInResponseDto { accessToken, refreshToken, user }. Emits SESSION_REFRESH UserToken.

dsItems.title: API contract — POST /auth/signup
dsItems.description: Body: SignUpDto { email, password, locale? }. Response: SignUpResponseDto. Creates User.isActive=false + ACCOUNT_VALIDATION UserToken; when the email module is installed, a validation email is queued.

dsItems.title: UI form — SignInPage
dsItems.description: web/src/pages/public/SignInPage.tsx — fields: email, password. Zod schema: email format + password min length. Submits via the useSigninMutation React Query hook.

tcItems.title: should sign in user successfully
tcItems.expectedResult: 200 with access + refresh tokens and User.lastLoginAt updated — see auth.service.spec.ts

tcItems.title: should throw UnauthorizedException if credentials are invalid
tcItems.expectedResult: 401 Unauthorized with generic message (same shape for unknown email and wrong password)

tcItems.title: should create a new user successfully
tcItems.expectedResult: User row with isActive=false + UserToken{type=ACCOUNT_VALIDATION} — see auth.service.spec.ts

tcItems.title: should handle existing user gracefully
tcItems.expectedResult: Signup with a duplicate email returns a generic response (no user-enumeration leak)

tcItems.title: should create account when signing in with confirmation token
tcItems.expectedResult: Consuming an ACCOUNT_VALIDATION token flips User.isActive=true and allows subsequent signin

tcItems.title: should sign out user successfully
tcItems.expectedResult: SESSION_REFRESH UserToken for the caller is deleted / revoked

nfrItems.title: Refresh token rotation on every use
nfrItems.target: SESSION_REFRESH UserToken is rotated on each refresh; old token is invalidated before the new one is issued

nfrItems.title: Auth endpoints rate-limited per IP
nfrItems.target: ≤ 5 failed signin attempts per IP per 60s — proposed, needs human validation

nfrItems.title: Auth error messages translated (FR + EN)
nfrItems.target: All user-facing error strings resolve through i18next in FR and EN — proposed, needs human validation

nfrItems.title: User deactivation flow via isActive flag
nfrItems.target: Admin can flip User.isActive=false to lock an account without deleting the row — proposed, needs human validation

nfrItems.title: Signin p95 latency ≤ 1 second
nfrItems.target: POST /auth/signin p95 ≤ 1s under expected concurrency — proposed, needs human validation
